title: Around the City
grammar: There is/There are; prepositions of place

exercises.instructions: Match each word with its Russian meaning.
Write two original English sentences using the target vocabulary. Then use at least one extra expression from the topic.
exercises.example_response: I use the word "library" when discussing around the city.
exercises.evaluation: Teacher reviews grammar, meaning and natural collocations.

exercises.instructions: Choose the correct form to complete each sentence.

questions.text: There ___ a library next to the park.
The bank is ___ the café and the museum.

exercises.instructions: Write two sentences about around the city that use There is/There are; prepositions of place. Include one question and one negative sentence.
exercises.answer_guidance: Check use of There is/There are; prepositions of place, spelling, word order, and whether the two sentences are meaningful.

exercises.title: Around the City — Reading
exercises.passage: Our neighbourhood has a small library opposite the park. There are two cafés near the town hall. The museum is between a bookshop and a bank. Visitors often ask for directions because the streets are narrow.

questions.question: What is between the bookshop and the bank?

exercises.title: Around the City — Listening
exercises.script: Visitor: Excuse me, where is the museum? Local: Go straight to the crossroads, turn left and walk past the café. The museum is on your right.
